subject: Private label loungewear
body: We are looking for soft modal loungewear sets with custom woven labels and private label packaging. Please share MOQ and target pricing.

subject: Plus size pajama range
body: Do you produce plus size pajamas up to 4X? We need consistent quality, breathable cotton and a low MOQ for a trial order.

subject: Silk sleepwear development
body: Interested in satin and silk-touch sleepwear, custom colors, samples and embroidered logo. What is your sample lead time?

subject: Bulk loungewear production
body: We need bulk production capacity for cotton loungewear sets with reliable delivery dates and stable quality.

subject: Breathable sleepwear
body: Looking for breathable lightweight fabrics, preferably bamboo or modal. Please advise MOQ, fabric options and certifications.

subject: Reorder and packaging
body: Can you confirm repeat-order quality consistency and provide custom hangtags, care labels and recyclable packaging?

subject: Custom printed robes
body: We are sourcing printed robes with custom artwork, color matching and durable fabric. Please quote 800 pieces per design.

subject: Small batch order
body: We need a low MOQ for a new loungewear range, soft fabric, custom logo and fast sample turnaround.

subject: Organic cotton pajamas
body: Please share GOTS-certified organic cotton options, size range, testing documents and bulk lead time.

subject: Production partner
body: We are looking for a supplier with large-volume capacity, reliable quality inspection, competitive cost and on-time delivery.

subject: Inclusive sizing
body: We want oversized relaxed-fit loungewear in modal jersey, including extended sizes. Samples and custom woven labels are required.

subject: Custom pajama set
body: Need cotton pajama sets with custom print, embroidery logo, hangtags and consistent color across repeat orders.
